authorization: User instructed to freeze research copier standard, fix analyzers and run reference; no live execution or production score acceptance.

target.unit: one standard copy session of one venue/address
target.current_reference_scope: short controlled engineering trace, not a complete 30-day historical outcome
target.metric: net terminal wealth relative to known opening wealth; unknown terminal marks prevent a point PnL

venue_scope.collateral: USDC.e-labelled historical scope; actual contract, decimals, fees must be verified before external financial replay

sizing.day_boundary: local IANA midnight; 23/25h DST days, UTC only for storage

signals.ordering: observed receipt sequence; equal time requires authoritative sequence, never sort by price

market_data.book_selection: latest available no later than decision; no wait for future book
market_data.missing_side: unknown unless verified producer contract explicitly proves empty
market_data.raw_timestamp_precision: preserve raw values; finer time is not exchange sequence without provenance
market_data.known_intervening_updates: apply only with verified continuity/order; otherwise no inferred executable current book

admission.price_limit: explicit applicable verified binding; missing means skip before intent
admission.expenses: documented applicable upper bound including asset/unit/rounding; missing means skip before intent
admission.unresolved_created_intent: retain purchase and expense reserves until verified reconciliation

bookkeeping.number_representation: Decimal or verified native integer amounts, never binary float cash
bookkeeping.native_quanta: require declared verified binding; engineering fixture may use explicit synthetic 0.000001 units
bookkeeping.quantity_rounding: conservative floor only under declared quantum
bookkeeping.expense_bound_rounding: conservative ceiling only under declared quantum
bookkeeping.confirmed_fills: authoritative trace events with identity, quantity, price, receivedAt and execution time; depth admission is not a fill
bookkeeping.cash_available: confirmed cash minus gross pending purchase reserve minus pending cash expenses
bookkeeping.position_limit: remaining tracked purchase cost basis plus pending gross purchase amount; expenses excluded
bookkeeping.daily_limit: confirmed buys by reliable execution local day plus unresolved gross amount carried into current day; expenses excluded
bookkeeping.late_confirmed_previous_day_fill: replaces corresponding reserve, charged to previous execution day, not current day
bookkeeping.fee_bound_release: terminal confirmation and specified reconciliation rule required; lower actual fee alone is not release evidence
bookkeeping.partial_cancel: keep every distinct confirmed fill; request is not cancel confirmation; only confirmed residual cancellation releases residual
bookkeeping.event_conflict: same ID with different payload blocks/quarantines; no duplicate debit

exits.proportional_sell: fraction of tracked copy quantity matching verified leader inventory reduction
exits.terminal_value: cash plus eligible same-token bid liquidation net of known applicable exit costs; unknown book/cost means unknown result
exits.future_resolution: not used before it is known at cutoff

controlled_fixture_binding.actual_fee_confirmation: terminal only; held bound persists through nonterminal full gross fill
controlled_fixture_binding.buy_price_cap_example: leader price + 0.02 USD/token only where explicitly supplied by fixture
controlled_fixture_binding.fixture_confirmations: constructed test oracle, not observed historical order executions

validation_scope.research_invariant_acceptance: exact ledger checks and fail-closed data tests
validation_scope.publication_authority: unchanged ADR rules; no publication performed
